label: Strange Sight, Hidden Cause
line: Open on a strange act or object in the middle of happening, give the cause in the second sentence, chain what follows, turn once, and stop on the most specific detail.
best_for: a curiosity about an animal, the body or an object, with one strange thing to show
an old practice that looks odd today
also_for: one object with a surprising job, told as what it is and what it does
avoid_for: a cause that takes more than a sentence or two
a sight the viewer has seen explained many times
anything with no single thing to look at
signals: there is one strange act or object to show
the cause fits in one sentence
it can be told in under a minute
a cost or a second fact turns it

beats.name: The sight
beats.job: The strange thing in the middle of happening. The why is held back.

beats.name: Cause
beats.job: Why it is done or why it happens, plainly.

beats.name: But
beats.job: The cost, or the second fact that turns it.

beats.name: Verdict or number
beats.job: The most specific detail, then stop.

hooks.shape: This is [thing]: [vivid description] that [what it does].

holds: The sight is on screen before it is explained, so the cause answers a question the viewer already has. The single turn in the second half gives a short script a second fact to wait for.
ending: One line that turns the opening's feeling around, or the most specific number. Nothing after it.
pitfalls: Padding past the band: this formula is short
template: [Strange act, in the middle of happening]. This is because [reason]. [Second reason]. So [consequence]. But [cost or hidden fact]. And [the most specific detail].
